en: On rice paper, vermilion traced, gold‑ink drifting, bamboo brush whispering. Each stroke follows your shadow, unseen yet present. This card honors the quiet companion who tags your every step, unnoticed. Full process at https://forerui.com/?src=x
zh: 宣纸细纹，朱砂脉络，金墨轻盈，枯笔随风。每一次轻触，都是影子在头顶舞动。此卡献给那种无声陪伴的你——你走到哪，我随形，却未被察觉。详细绘制见 https://forerui.com/?src=x
